title: Dependency Graph Analysis
key_findings: Zero circular dependencies detected - excellent acyclic architecture with flat structure (max depth 1)
17 version conflicts across requirements files, primarily between requirements.txt and requirements_tf_metal.txt
1 unconstrained dependency (ipykernel in requirements_tf_metal.txt) poses security and stability risks
Core ML libraries (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, xgboost) have conflicting version specifications across environments
27 isolated modules (44% of total) need review for potential consolidation or integration
Entry point files (main.py with 27 imports, buddy_scanner.py with 21 imports) show high coupling
Hub modules well-organized in core infrastructure (modular_data_loaders, feature_engineering, modular_inference)
Import distribution healthy: 42% standard library, 45% third-party, 13% local
1 deprecated package (ipython) but still maintained with no immediate action required
Mixed version constraint patterns (pinned vs range) without clear policy
immediate_actions: Add version constraint to ipykernel in requirements_tf_metal.txt (0.5 hours)
Document TensorFlow environment strategy explaining platform-specific version differences (2 hours)
Add inline documentation to requirements files explaining environment-specific packages (2 hours)
Unify core ML library versions across all environments (4 hours)
Create version policy document defining when to use pinned vs range versions (4 hours)
recommendations: Implement automated dependency validation in CI/CD pipeline to prevent unconstrained dependencies
Refactor main.py and buddy_scanner.py to reduce import counts and improve modularity
Audit and consolidate 27 isolated modules to reduce code bloat and improve integration
Consider using pip-tools or poetry for dependency locking to improve reproducibility
Integrate security scanning (pip-audit or safety) to monitor for vulnerabilities
Implement dependency injection to reduce coupling and improve testability
Create module dependency visualization to improve understanding of architecture
Establish regular dependency review process (monthly) to maintain dependency health
Consider TensorFlow version unification after documenting environment-specific optimizations
Automate dependency updates using Dependabot or Renovate to reduce maintenance burden
